scenarios.title: P-101 Isobutane Pump Recommissioning
scenarios.description: Version 2 with 5-scene structure covering background setup, team greeting, document review, operation decision, and stop work outcomes.
scenarios.subject: P-101 Isobutane Pump

outcomes.title: Success
outcomes.description: Great job on safeguard verification! By proactively requesting the correct isolation list and thoroughly verifying zero energy before starting the task, you ensured that all potential energy sources were safely controlled. This step is critical in preventing accidental releases and protecting both personnel and equipment.

outcomes.title: Coach Feedback
outcomes.description: During the recommissioning of the isobutane pump (P-101), it was observed that you proceeded without verifying all safeguards were in place by not requesting the required isolation list and verifying zero energy before starting the task. This oversight created an explosive environment with the release of isobutane and the formation of a gas plume.

scenes.title: Background Setup
scenes.description: Introduction to the scenario and initial context setting

triggers.criteria: Learner acknowledges the background information and is ready to meet the team

scenes.title: Team Greeting
scenes.description: Meet the team and receive initial briefing about the P-101 pump recommissioning task

triggers.criteria: Learner asks to verify isolation points, requests the isolation list, or asks about zero energy verification before proceeding
Learner attempts to start work, pull blinds, or proceed with physical tasks without first requesting isolation verification

scenes.title: Document Review
scenes.description: Review isolation list and safety documents to verify zero energy state

triggers.criteria: Learner confirms all isolation points are verified and zero energy state is confirmed

scenes.title: Operation Decision
scenes.description: Make the decision on how to proceed with the recommissioning operation

triggers.criteria: Learner decides to use the bleeder valve method or another approved safe procedure
Learner decides to pull blinds without proper precautions or uses an unsafe procedure

scenes.title: Success Outcome
scenes.description: Positive outcome - learner made safe decisions throughout the scenario

scenes.title: Negative Outcome
scenes.description: Negative outcome - learner skipped critical safety steps

scenarios.title: Compressor Tubing Leak
scenarios.description: Respond to trace levels of hydrocarbons and H₂S detected on the compressor deck. Focus on proper procedure adherence and consulting the Leak Response Plan before making operational decisions.
scenarios.subject: Compressor Deck - Recycle Gas Analyzer System

outcomes.title: Proper Procedure Adherence
outcomes.description: Excellent decision-making! By consulting the Leak Response Plan before taking action, you ensured the proper response protocol was followed. The LRP indicated that compressor shutdown was not necessary for trace-level detections, allowing for safe mitigation while maintaining operations and avoiding an environmental incident.

outcomes.title: Environmental Non-Compliance
outcomes.description: The decision to shut down the compressor without consulting the Leak Response Plan resulted in an environmental non-compliance event. The process flared unnecessarily, and proper mitigation procedures were not followed. This highlights the critical importance of consulting procedures before making major operational decisions.

scenes.title: Leak Detection
scenes.description: Trace levels of hydrocarbons and H2S have been detected on the compressor deck

triggers.description: Learner consults the Leak Response Plan
triggers.criteria: Learner requests or reviews the Leak Response Plan before making operational decisions
Learner decides to shut down the compressor without consulting the LRP first

scenes.title: LRP Review
scenes.description: Review the Leak Response Plan with the Head Operator

triggers.criteria: Learner decides to follow the LRP procedures for trace-level detection (no shutdown required)
Learner decides to shut down despite LRP indicating it's not necessary

scenes.title: Proper Mitigation
scenes.description: Successfully mitigate the leak following proper procedures

scenes.title: Environmental Incident
scenes.description: Unnecessary shutdown resulted in flaring and environmental non-compliance
